hero.title:
PG Diploma in AI-Driven Digital Branding & Advertising
(PG Diploma in AI DBA)

panes.label: Overview
panes.text:
The PG Diploma in AI-Driven Digital Branding & Advertising (PG Diploma in AI DBA) at ATLAS ISME is a future-ready, industry-aligned program blending creativity, AI, data, and digital technologies.

One of the first advertising-focused PGs, it integrates AI deeply across creative, media, content, analytics, and strategy. Designed with industry leaders, the one-year program equips students to thrive at the intersection of creativity, technology, and strategy in an AI-driven marketing world.

The curriculum covers creative AI, predictive analytics, automation, and conversational tools. Hands-on AI Labs, Creative Tech Labs, and full-funnel campaign projects help students build professional portfolios. Industry-grade AdTech and MarTech platforms, generative AI tools, dashboards, and predictive models prepare learners to design, execute, and optimise end-to-end campaigns.

With a compulsory internship and AI-augmented capstone project, students gain real-world experience. Portfolio-led learning, live client briefs, and ethical AI practices ensure graduates are career-ready. PG Diploma in AI-DBA offers a fast-track, high-impact alternative to traditional MBA programs for future leaders in digital branding and advertising.

cards.title: Foundations of Digital Branding & Marketing in the Age of AI
Creative Tech Labs, Full-Funnel Campaign Simulations

cards.text: Gain strong foundations in digital branding, advertising strategy, and AI-driven marketing ecosystems
Create impactful content, campaigns, and brand narratives using generative AI and creative technologies
Plan, execute, and optimise performance marketing and media campaigns using data, automation, and predictive analytics
Leverage AdTech and MarTech platforms to personalise customer journeys and improve campaign ROI
Apply consumer insights, social analytics, and AI-powered measurement models to inform strategic decisions
Develop end-to-end, full-funnel digital advertising solutions through hands-on projects, live briefs, capstone, and internship

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Gain a rigorous introduction to the foundations of digital branding, advertising, and AI-driven marketing strategies. This semester focuses on building analytical, creative, and business communication skills essential for a career in AI-powered marketing, brand management, and digital advertising.

title.strong: Marketing in the Age of AI

courses.text: Explores how artificial intelligence transforms marketing strategy, personalisation, automation, ethics, and consumer engagement.
Builds storytelling skills to create emotionally compelling, insight-driven advertising campaigns across diverse media platforms.
Examines social platforms, influencer strategies, content creation, analytics, and community-driven brand growth models.
Focuses on ROI-driven digital marketing using AI-powered analytics, attribution, testing, and predictive optimisation.
Teaches using AI tools to analyse data, generate insights, and support strategic marketing decisions.

title.strong: Creative Tech Lab 1: AI-powered Campaign Development

courses.text: Hands-on lab applying AI tools to ideate, design, and execute integrated marketing campaigns.
Allows students to specialise in selected AI-driven marketing or creative communication domains.
Introduces portfolio building through structured documentation of academic and creative marketing projects.

list.title: Marketing Automation & AI-Transformed Customer Journeys
list.text: Explores AI-powered automation, personalisation, CRM integration, and optimised end-to-end customer journey design.

list.title: Copywriting & Visual Communication using AI
list.text: Develops persuasive copywriting and visual storytelling skills using AI-assisted creative tools

list.title: Google Cloud – Introduction to Generative AI
list.text: Introduces generative AI concepts, use cases, large language models, and responsible AI practices.

list.title: Google Ads – Google
list.text: Builds practical skills in creating, managing, and optimising digital advertising campaigns using Google Ads.

list.title: Content Marketing – HubSpot
list.text: Covers content strategy, creation, distribution, SEO, and performance measurement for brand growth.

list.title: Social Media Marketing – HubSpot
list.text: Teaches social media strategy, publishing, engagement, analytics, and campaign optimisation techniques.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Develop expertise in AI-driven marketing strategies, digital brand management, and advanced advertising technologies, while deepening practical skills through hands-on labs and real-world campaign simulations. The curriculum emphasizes data ethics, consumer privacy, and real-time analysis of digital marketing and advertising performance.

title.strong: Media Management and AI-based Programmatic Advertising

courses.text: Covers media planning, buying, and optimisation using AI-driven programmatic advertising technologies.
Focuses on building consistent brand strategy through integrated, multi-channel marketing communications.
Teaches analytical models, attribution, experimentation, and measurement of advertising effectiveness.

title.strong: Applied AI and AdTech and MarTech

courses.text: Explores practical AI applications across advertising and marketing technology platforms and ecosystems.

title.strong: Consumer & AI-powered Commerce & AI-powered Consumer Experience

courses.text: Analyses consumer behavior and AI-enabled commerce experiences across digital and omnichannel touchpoints.

title.strong: Creative Tech Lab 2: Full-Funnel AI-optimised Campaign

courses.text: Advanced lab executing AI-optimised campaigns across awareness, consideration, conversion, and retention stages.
Offers advanced specialisation in AI-driven optimisation, analytics, listening, or digital experience strategies.
Refines professional portfolio with advanced projects, case studies, and industry-ready marketing work.
Provides real-world industry exposure applying AI-powered marketing skills in professional environments.

list.title: Website Optimisation & CRO using AI-Stack
list.text: Focuses on AI-driven UX analysis, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimisation strategies.

list.title: AI-based Social Listening and ORM
list.text: Teaches AI-powered monitoring, analysis, and management of online conversations and brand reputation.

list.title: Google Cloud – Machine Learning Crash Course (MLCC)
list.text: Provides foundational understanding of machine learning concepts and applications relevant to marketing analytics.

list.title: Google Analytics 4 – Google
list.text: Builds expertise in event-based analytics, reporting, and insights using GA4.

list.title: Amazon Ads for Retail – Amazon
list.text: Covers retail advertising strategies, sponsored ads, targeting, and optimisation within Amazon’s ecosystem.

list.title: Google My Business – Google
list.text: Teaches local business profile optimisation, customer engagement, reviews, and local SEO fundamentals.
